desc: 挂盒主图开场，用空白适配表与样张讲清输出与适配
leaf: 喷墨打印机黑色替换墨盒
name: 喷墨打印黑色墨盒替换装款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用干净的挂孔零售盒剪影赢下第一眼的正品感。
一秒讲清换装后的成品观感，用两叠扇开的打印样张承接主图利益点。
放大条纹、斑驳、褪色这一页就废了的焦虑，把换装动机推到台前。
用放大镜下的纤维与网点密度证明墨色落料扎实，做实细节证据。
用两叠纸的高度差把耐用主张视觉化，两侧留空标签带由卖家自填。
shots.textZone: two square-cornered ribbon bars near each stack base sized for 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 把机型适配疑虑交给一张空白两列表自查，消除买错风险而不写任何机型。
把断墨焦虑换成门口到货的确定感，让买家代入家用办公日常。
黑盒与彩盒同框并列，让买家一眼选到要补的那一支。
用空盒回寄动作与三行空白说明降低决策风险，只讲处理方式的确定性。
深色收口把整套情绪压回货架感，留出空白收口带引导下单。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white sweep #FFFFFF for packshots, cool grey-blue panel #E9EEF3 for infographic screens, one deep charcoal #1C1F23 sweep for the close, all with hard edge-free falloff
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons, square-cornered ribbon bars and empty badge frames in the locked palette, no pictograms that carry brand meaning
style.lightingSystem: bright neutral-cool high-key studio light, front-left key with fill card, soft short contact shadows, no harsh speculars, every device display left blank and unlit
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium office-consumables ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, cool grey-blue panel #E9EEF3, deep charcoal #1C1F23 and one bright cyan accent #1B9DDD; neutral-cool high-key studio lighting with a front-left key, fill card and soft short contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with one headline band per screen; thin single-weight line icons, square-cornered ribbon bars and empty badge frames only; clean high-end packshot photography mixed with minimal blank infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 product angle and identical product scale; compatible device bodies always blank, unbranded and unlit; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no legible words inside printed samples or on packaging faces
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 packshot angle and identical cartridge scale across the set, packaging faces kept as blank fields with empty badge frames, compatible device bodies always unbranded and unprinted
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale laminate counter #F2F4F6, plain matte paper stacks, unprinted kraft parcel surface and a woven jute threshold mat #B99A6B
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one headline band per screen, wide letter spacing, all copy carried by placeholders only
